parts.text: I add new drones to the fleet, retire old ones, set up our charging pads at our sites, take drones out of service for repairs and put them back, and send drones to charge. Our company runs a few hundred drones of several models from different manufacturers, which differ in payload capacity, range, sensors, and charging connectors. We have a few dozen charging pads at our own sites, and pads are never lent to another company.
